summary: NetEase filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: current report on Form 8-K) attaching a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return dated Sept 28, 2026. The filing discloses routine share-plan activity: 416,865 treasury shares transferred at US$0.00 on Sept 1 for 2019 Share Incentive Plan vesting, plus a modest 15,695-share repurchase at US$22.9784 on Sept 25, leaving 3,201,652,151 issued shares and 10,403,505 treasury shares. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or close date given. Watch for continued buyback pacing and dilution from incentive awards.
